environment: Windows, Conan Release, Qt offscreen, QT_FONT_DPI=96, default Windows text backend, 960x900 DPR1
methodology: Two sequential fresh-process series per size, without a concurrent build or test. The primary after series is the second Release measurement after the style/memory changes; preliminary_samples retains the first series. The later pending-range guard affects rejected caret requests outside this workload and is validated separately in the final full suite. Each series follows the same fixed CSS, workload and stage ordering as round 10. Exclusive times exclude nested scopes. Working sets are point-in-time samples, not peaks. The additional full-reference stage runs last and is excluded from comparable working-set maxima. These offscreen samples are not real GUI latency distributions.
scope: Exact text-only semantic proof, sparse AST rebinding retaining CSS identities/style/interaction recipes, CSS page-tail geometry parity, reference-counted exact semantic signatures and weakly interned immutable counter states.

edit_stages.edit: Original heading-title insertion, then local layout rebuild.
edit_stages.edit_plain: After edit, inserts Plain edit inside the first paragraph, then local range rebuild.
edit_stages.edit_numbering: After edit_plain, inserts an h1 at the beginning and propagates following counters.
edit_stages.counter_full_reference: Additional validation after all measured edits: rebuilds a fresh theme, resolves counters from scratch, and compares every generated block string and fingerprint. Allocations cannot warm earlier measured stages.

storage_notes: semantic_bytes counts unique serialized signature payload only; unshared_semantic_bytes is the sum of each live block payload without sharing. Neither includes allocator/container overhead. shared_states counts live immutable snapshots, not counter instances. Tests also compare ordinary/structural intermediate edits with fresh styles/layouts and verify release of old signatures/states.

pending_range_regression.environment: Existing 2 MiB mixed/nested Markdown integration test with EditorView and default theme, Qt offscreen; separate from VLOOK benchmark samples.
pending_range_regression.cause: A synchronous caret request invalidated styles and traversed counters before rejecting a stale layout whose structural range update was still queued. Slot count and identity are now validated first.
